question: B is the father of C. C is the brother of Q. Q is the son of M's son. M is married to T. B is the only son of T. T is the mother of U. How is T related to Q?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/496368278e51fd33f2bee9b301a733a33389bdc9d0f2d4fae5af0b40056affd1.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a3d852519af77e2dc8d4751b9ed0a522152de51bc5b0e9edec9330322ce215c.png] 

T is grandmother of Q i.e., Q's father's mother.

Hence, ‘**Father's mother**’ is the correct answer.
